query:
UPDATE email_outbox
               SET status = CASE WHEN $3::float8 IS NULL THEN 'failed'::email_status ELSE 'pending'::email_status END,
                   next_attempt_at = COALESCE(now() + make_interval(secs => $3), next_attempt_at),
                   last_error = $2,
                   locked_until = NULL
               WHERE id = $1
